summary: Confirmed $33 base (all electric), not waterfront. Added 50A, 34 sites (23 usable by a motorhome, 35-65 ft), latrines/dump/water, off-peak $29, 14-night max, $6.50 fee. Pin is 185 m from the centroid, within tolerance.
flags: PHONE BLANK: the ODNR campground page lists (740) 682-6197 under its phone block. The park page's office is (740) 858-6652 c/o Shawnee State Park. Reservations (866) 644-6727.

WATERFRONT stays 'not waterfront' on what I could measure, with a small lead: drive-in sites nearest the lake (10, 11, 12, 14, 26, 27) plot about 40-60 m from the water through a wooded strip on leaf-on imagery, and the walk-in sites (4-8, 28-32) are the ones at the shore. No ODNR or engine site tag claims water. I could not reach Ohio OSIP's leaf-off service, so a winter lake view from sites 10-14 is not ruled out.
PIN OK: stored 38.9017,-82.5965 is 185 m from the centroid of 33 sites (38.9032,-82.5955), inside the campground. Under the 250 m bar, so left alone.
No split, no closure notice on the ODNR pages.
